STEPS.LOGIN: Log in with your Meta account in the window that opens.
STEPS.NUMBER: Choose or confirm the number you use in the WhatsApp Business app.
STEPS.VERIFY: Meta sends a message with a verification code to your WhatsApp Business app. Choose Enter code and paste that code into the Meta window, or scan the QR code from another screen. Choose whether to share your history from the last 6 months.

CHANGES.HISTORY: If you share your history, 1:1 chats and contacts from the last 6 months are synced.
CHANGES.MESSAGES: Disappearing messages are disabled and view-once messages are not supported.
CHANGES.ACTIVITY: Use the WhatsApp Business app on your phone at least every 14 days. After about 14 days without using the primary device, Meta disconnects the account from the API; additional devices disconnect after about 30 days.
CHANGES.VERSION: You need WhatsApp Business version 2.24.17 or later.
CHANGES.THROUGHPUT: Your number has a fixed throughput of 20 messages per second.
CHANGES.DISCONNECT: To disconnect your account: WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → WhatsApp Business Platform → Disconnect account.
